title: Conflict Detection Log Entry
description: Audit-grade record of a multi-agent recommendation conflict detected by the post-return, deterministic, rule-based detector defined in ADR-18 / FR-RAG-COORD-01. Source of truth: Cosmos DB container `conflictDetectionLog` in Australia East (NN-2 + FR-RAG-CV-04). One row per conflict event; the same `conflict_group_id` is also written to every implicated `AuditRecord.conflict_group_id` so trace stitching works without a JOIN. Detection is reactive (post-return) — Pass 2 Q-P2-06 explicitly rejects pre-emptive divergence detection because it breaks Constitution Principle IV deterministic replay.

conflict_group_id.description: UUID v7 (time-ordered) used to link this conflict log entry to every implicated `AuditRecord.conflict_group_id`. Cosmos DB partition key.

detected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of detection. Detector runs in the recommendation-aggregation layer after both agents return, NOT during inference (Pass 2 Q-P2-06).

conflict_class.description: One of the four deterministic conflict classes defined in ADR-18: resource (same `resource_id` claimed in overlapping time windows), spatial (incompatible recommendations covering overlapping `(geo_bbox, time_window)`), temporal (action verbs with mutually exclusive deadlines), severity (hazard severity buckets with delta ≥1 AIIMS incident level for the same hazard).

agent_recommendations.description: The pair (or set) of agent recommendations that triggered the detector. Each item points back to its `AuditRecord.call_id` so the audit trail is fully reconstructible.

audit_call_id.description: Foreign key to `AuditRecord.call_id` for this agent's recommendation.

recommendation_summary.description: Free-text summary of the recommendation as seen by the detector. Used by Ops Officer / IC to triage without re-reading the audit log.

resource_id.description: Required for `conflict_class == 'resource'`. The contested resource (e.g. helicopter tail number, evacuation centre id).

geo_bbox.description: Required for `conflict_class == 'spatial'`. WGS84 bounding box `[west, south, east, north]`.

time_window.description: Required for `conflict_class in ('resource', 'spatial', 'temporal')`. ISO-8601 UTC window.

escalation_state.description: AIIMS escalation chain state (Pass 1 Q-P1-03). Initial value `awaiting_ops_officer`; on 5-min unack timeout transitions to `escalated_to_ic`; on full-AIIMS-unreachable + degraded-connectivity transitions to `field_coordinator_queued`.

current_owner.description: Identity of the AIIMS role currently responsible for resolution (Ops Officer Entra ID at first detection; transitions to IC on 5-min unack per Pass 1 Q-P1-03; null when queued for offline review).

escalated_to_ic_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Set when escalation_state transitions to `escalated_to_ic` (i.e., 5 minutes after detection without Ops Officer ack). Recorded for `escalation_unack_timeout` audit metric.

resolution.description: Set when escalation_state transitions to `resolved`. Captures which recommendation was accepted/rejected and by whom (FR-RAG-COORD-02).

accepted_audit_call_id.description: Which agent's recommendation was accepted (or null if neither — the resolver issued an independent action).

field_coordinator_offline_queue.description: Set when escalation_state == 'field_coordinator_queued' (Pass 1 Q-P1-03 offline branch). Field Coordinator MUST NOT auto-resolve cross-agent conflicts; this is a queue marker, not a resolution.

agent_recommendations.recommendation_summary: Evacuate Bega Valley LGA south of Princes Hwy effective immediately.
Shelter-in-place recommended for Bega Valley LGA south of Princes Hwy due to road network compromise.
